summary: This note is a short biography of Brandon Corp, a lacrosse player for Colgate University in Division I college lacrosse. It covers his four seasons with the Raiders from 2006 to 2009, including his team's record, his scoring rank, and team achievements as a junior. It also notes that the Boston Cannons drafted him fourth in the 2009 MLL draft and summarizes his 2009 season stats.
one_line: Brandon Corp is a Colgate University lacrosse player (2006-2009) who was drafted fourth by the Boston Cannons in 2009.
key_facts: Brandon Corp was born on March 2, 1987.
Brandon Corp is a lacrosse player for Colgate University in Division I college lacrosse.
Corp played for the Raiders from 2006 to 2009.
The Raiders went 42 and 20 during Corp's four years with the team.
Corp ended his senior season as the 4th leading scorer in the nation.
As a junior, Corp led the Raiders to a Patriot League title.
As a junior, Corp led the Raiders to an NCAA tournament appearance.
The Boston Cannons selected Brandon Corp with the fourth pick of the 2009 MLL draft.
Brandon Corp finished the 2009 season with 8 goals and 3 assists.
Brandon Corp totaled 11 points in 7 games in the 2009 season.
